• The given word is **"Confirm**," which means to establish the truth or correctness of something (सत्यापित करना) 
 
• The correct word that means the same as** "Confirm" **is **"Corroborate," **meaning to confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding (पुष्टि करना). 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Corroborate'.**
